issue: A transient Full-JD failure could degrade location/deadline/status metadata and falsely classify previously known vacancies as MATERIALLY_CHANGED or REOPENED, polluting daily_actionable.
observed_pattern: 30 Madrid POEM_RELAY_HTTP_504 rows all carried DETAIL_UNRESOLVED; 23 were MATERIALLY_CHANGED and 7 REOPENED.
fix: During resolved-to-unresolved detail degradation, compare only stable identity fields title/company, suppress false reopen caused by degraded status, and retain the prior trustworthy enriched metadata/detail snapshot.
